result_text:
`all_files.zip` now takes its entry names from the configured aspect names, so renaming a scope aspect no longer breaks it. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or generate a report, so I haven't confirmed the renamed-aspect output.

The fix is in `DataExporter.java`, in the zip-writing block near the end of the export. It replaces the five hard-coded `aspect_*.txt` literals. It now takes the main, test, generated, build-and-deployment and other aspects, in that order. For each one it uses `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same helper that names the loose text files. That name is used both to read the file and as the zip entry name.

- **Default config:** the entries are the same five names in the same order, including `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt`.
- **Renamed aspect:** the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`.
- **`git-history.zip`:** it is written after `all_files.zip` in the same block. The old failure on the missing file skipped it, so it is written again when a `git-history.txt` exists.

I didn't touch the other hard-coded `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt` in `LandscapeAnalyzer.java:283`, which reads the file by that literal name. It may have the same problem with a renamed aspect.
